name: Revelations of Divine Love
desc: A book of poetry said to have been composed by a priest of the ancient Church of Favonius under the guidance of the Anemo Archon. The work reflects on the distinction between the love of the gods and human love, and ultimately concludes that human compassion, friendship, and romantic affection are all inherently imbued with the sacred, for they all arise from the same longing for freedom.
